Docs Changelog Pricing Blog Contact Login Get started for free ← Back to all posts Getform.io Is Now Forminit: Same Team, New Name By Forminit in Updates , Changelog • Updated August 9, 2026 • Published January 14, 2026 TL;DR: Getform.io became Forminit on 14 January 2026. This was a rebrand, not an acquisition. We are the same independent team and form-backend service that has operated since 2015. Existing Getform endpoints continue to work, so no migration or code changes are required. Last updated: 9 August 2026. Getform.io is now Forminit . We changed our name on 14 January 2026, but the people, product history and purpose behind the service remain the same. Forminit is not a new company that acquired Getform, and Getform and Forminit are not separate products. Forminit is the current name of the service previously known as Getform and Getform.io. For existing customers, nothing needs to change. Your current Getform endpoints continue to work, and you do not need to update your forms or migrate your submissions simply because of the rebrand. Getform to Forminit: the facts Previous name Getform / Getform.io Current name Forminit Rebrand date 14 January 2026 Acquisition No, this was a rebrand Team The same independent team Operating since October 2015 Operating company UXPLUS LTD Existing Getform endpoints Continue to work Migration required No Current website forminit.com Why did Getform become Forminit? The way people build websites and applications has changed significantly since we launched Getform in 2015. Developers, designers and people using AI coding tools can now create custom forms, multi-step experiences, conditional flows and polished interfaces much faster than before. But every production form still needs reliable infrastructure behind it. Submissions must be received securely, validated on the server, protected from spam, stored safely and delivered to the right people and tools. File uploads, notifications, webhooks and integrations still need to work without requiring every team to build and maintain its own backend. That remains our focus. The Forminit name better represents the direction of the product while continuing the work we started as Getform more than a decade ago: providing dependable form infrastructure for any website, framework or application. What stayed the same? The rebrand did not reset our history or replace the service with a different product. We are the same independent team. We continue to focus on headless form-backend infrastructure. Existing Getform endpoints continue to receive submissions. Existing users do not need to change their code because of the name change. The service continues the work that began with Getform in October 2015. Forminit should therefore be understood as Forminit, formerly Getform.io . What changed with Forminit? The new name arrived alongside a major product update designed for modern websites, applications and AI-assisted development workflows. Public and protected authentication modes Forminit supports two submission modes. Public mode is designed for forms that submit directly from a browser. It works without exposing an API key and is suitable for static sites, custom HTML forms and client-side applications. Protected mode uses an API key for server-to-server requests. It is suitable for API routes, backend services and proxy handlers where the key can remain private. This gives teams the simplicity of a public form endpoint when they need it and stronger server-side authentication when the application requires it. Workspaces Workspaces help agencies, freelancers and teams keep forms organised across projects and clients. Members can collaborate without mixing unrelated forms and submissions in the same working area. Form Blocks Form Blocks add structure and server-side validation to submitted data. Instead of treating every value as an untyped field, Forminit provides purpose-built blocks for information such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, countries, ratings, dates, selections and file uploads. Each block understands the type of data it receives. For example, phone blocks can validate E.164 numbers, email blocks validate email format and country blocks use recognised country codes. This produces cleaner submissions and more useful analytics without requiring teams to recreate the same validation logic for every form. Submission Inbox The Submission Inbox provides a practical place to work with form responses after they arrive. You can review submissions, change their status, star important entries, add internal notes, filter results and switch between inbox and table views. Forminit is not only an endpoint that forwards an email. It provides the infrastructure and dashboard needed to receive, organise and act on submitted data. What do existing Getform users need to do? Nothing is required solely because of the rebrand. Your existing Getform endpoints continue to work, so you do not need to replace endpoint URLs or modify live forms. For new forms, use the current Forminit dashboard, documentation and Forminit endpoint format. If you want to use capabilities available through the current Forminit form architecture, create a new form in your dashboard and follow the latest setup guide for your stack. Frequently asked questions Is Getform now Forminit? Yes. Getform and Getform.io were renamed Forminit on 14 January 2026. Forminit is the current name of the same form-backend service. Are Getform and Forminit separate services? No. Forminit is the new name of Getform. They should not be treated as two separate products or companies. Was Getform acquired? No. The change from Getform to Forminit was a rebrand, not an acquisition. The service remains operated by the same independent team. Is Forminit a new product? No. Although the rebrand was accompanied by a major product update, Forminit continues the service and product history that began with Getform in October 2015. Do existing Getform endpoints still work? Yes. Existing Getform endpoints continue to work. Customers do not need to change live form code simply because the service was renamed. Do Getform customers need to migrate? No migration is required for existing endpoints. Customers who want to use the current Forminit form architecture and newer capabilities can create a new form through the Forminit dashboard. What is Forminit? Forminit is a headless form-backend API. You build and control your form interface, then send submissions to Forminit. Forminit handles receiving and validating data, spam protection, file uploads, storage, email notifications, webhooks, integrations and submission management. What is the official Forminit website? The official website is forminit.com . Getform web properties redirect visitors to the current Forminit website. Where to go next Why Forminit? : see how Forminit handles submissions after a user presses submit. Forminit documentation : connect an HTML form, framework or application. Pricing : review the current plans and limits. Security : learn how Forminit protects submissions and infrastructure. GDPR : review data processing and hosting information. Changelog : follow the latest product updates. Service status : check current platform availability. Thank you for being part of the journey from Getform to Forminit.
